# Tiny FST fixtures

`tiny.fst` is a deterministic correctness fixture generated by
`fst-writer` 0.3.1 (BSD-3-Clause). It contains one nested signal, one alias,
and two scalar changes. `tiny.oracle.json` is its format-neutral semantic
oracle.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```sh
cargo run --locked --example generate_fst_fixtures
sha256sum tests/fixtures/fst/tiny.fst
```

Expected SHA-256:

```text
5934da5ec2a9ef5c6cd819f85e2e8bdde440e431796f9fdd3057cde635e265e2  tiny.fst
```

The generator is `tests/fixtures/fst/generator.rs`; the Cargo example is only
a reproducible entry point. Tests regenerate the file in a temporary
directory and compare it byte-for-byte with the committed binary before
checking the semantic oracle. A writer upgrade must deliberately regenerate
the fixture, update this hash, and pass the semantic checks.

This fixture is intentionally minimal. Extended digital states, vectors,
real/string values, same-timestamp ordering, malformed inputs, and equivalent
VCD/FST pairs remain tracked by FST-F0-T03 through FST-F0-T05.
